Frozen config, percent/fraction marker factor and antichain/native reload are consistent with prospective design; no demonstrated critical adapter/geometry bug
High sampled search recall is distinct from the low same-origin oral neighbor purity; cannot assert full composite-neighbor optimality
E009 and oral differ in upstream learning, community, assembly/length and truth; endpoint differences do not causally identify depth
